extension.summary: Shared code, questions and skin for OpenTrivia and its screensaver
extension.description: Holds the 49,000-question OpenTriviaQA database, the block reader both front-ends use, the theme engine and the shared window skin. Installed automatically with OpenTrivia or the OpenTrivia screensaver. The question data is CC BY-SA 4.0 from the OpenTriviaQA project (https://github.com/uberspot/OpenTriviaQA); the code is MIT.
